title: HilbertGen-3D:Hilbert--Multifractal Conditioning for Topology-Aware 3D Generation
title_zh: HilbertGen-3D：用于拓扑感知3D生成的希尔伯特多重分形条件化方法

paragraphs.en: 总结：HilbertGen-3D提出基于希尔伯特多重分形条件的拓扑感知扩散框架，显著提升3D点云生成质量与多样性。 High-fidelity 3D generative modeling underpins game asset creation, medical imaging, and VR/AR environmental design, where geometric structure directly influences perception and decision-making. Diffusion models represent a powerful paradigm for point cloud generation. However, existing approaches rely heavily on local voxel or patch features and often miss global structural organization, and much less work has studied how global conditioning can be used to improve generation quality. In this paper, we introduce HilbertGen-3D, a novel topology-aware conditional diffusion framework based on Hilbert-Multifractal Conditioning (HMC). HMC computes multi-scale voxel measures, serializes them via a 3D Hilbert curve to expose structured spatial dependencies, and estimates the generalized fractal dimensions from scale-dependent partition functions. We encode these signals as global embeddings and multi-scale tokens, and inject them into a diffusion denoiser through an efficient bottleneck fusion module. Across the Chair, Airplane, and Car categories of ShapeNet, our two conditioning variants reduce the absolute deviation of 1-Nearest Neighbor Accuracy (1-NNA) from 50% by up to 8.90 percentage points and increase coverage by up to 5.88 percentage points relative to TopoDiT-3D. This shows that combining local density cues with global Hilbert-multifractal structure provides a simple and effective recipe for high-fidelity and diverse 3D generation.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：HilbertGen-3D提出基于希尔伯特多重分形条件的拓扑感知扩散框架，显著提升3D点云生成质量与多样性。高保真3D生成建模是游戏资产创建、医学成像以及VR/AR环境设计的基础，在这些领域中，几何结构直接影响感知与决策。 扩散模型是点云生成的一种强大范式。 然而，现有方法严重依赖局部体素或补丁特征，往往遗漏全局结构组织，而对如何利用全局条件来提升生成质量的研究则更少。 在本文中，我们提出HilbertGen-3D，一种基于希尔伯特-多重分形条件（HMC）的新型拓扑感知条件扩散框架。 HMC计算多尺度体素度量，通过3D希尔伯特曲线对其进行序列化以揭示结构化的空间依赖关系，并从依赖尺度的配分函数中估计广义分形维度。 我们将这些信号编码为全局嵌入与多尺度标记，并通过一个高效的瓶颈融合模块将其注入扩散去噪器。 在ShapeNet的椅子、飞机和汽车类别上，相对于TopoDiT-3D，我们的两种条件化变体将1-最近邻准确率（1-NNA）相对50%的绝对偏差最多降低8.90个百分点，并将覆盖率最多提升5.88个百分点。 这表明，将局部密度线索与全局希尔伯特-多重分形结构相结合，为实现高保真且多样的3D生成提供了一种简单而有效的方案。
